framework.limits: No actual occurrence probabilities, costs, power, source prevalence or RPN

options.necessary_when: actual lawfully sourced benchmark is feasible
options.falsifier: Prospective eligible items lack visible material facts, valid temporal ontology or rights
options.change: lawful rights, predeclared full sampling frame and coverage, complete label-changing-fact parity, independent blind correct gold/rater, prereg threshold/uncertainty, permit for execution
options.tradeoff: Keeps original question, but legality/measurement validity unknown and cost not estimated

options.necessary_when: identified, prospectively bounded subfamily is provably invalid and narrower one valid
options.falsifier: Outcome-driven restriction or suppressed rejection denominator means F-H01 selection bias
options.change: independently documented localized failure and predeclared narrower construct, with excluded candidate denominator and rights/parity
options.tradeoff: Potentially smaller budget but unjustified post-hoc narrowing risks false high performance

options.necessary_when: current source or ontology structurally fails despite lawful inspection
options.falsifier: One lawful sufficiently complete existing-family oracle undercuts asserted need to pivot
options.change: proof of present construct failure plus alternative source/ontology with valid info-budget contrast and new QuestionID owner decision
options.tradeoff: Unknown cost and new question/assumptions; no comparator yet

options.necessary_when: proof of no lawful valid path or untenable prespecified resources
options.falsifier: A credible lawful feasible path refutes impossibility
options.change: auditable proof all relevant source/ontology/parity alternatives fail or prospectively bounded resource ceiling infeasible
options.tradeoff: May avoid sunk cost but unjustified irreversible rejection now

options.necessary_when: evidence sufficient to answer Q3 only, not to admit actual measurement, and no additional admissible evidence now
options.falsifier: Proof on frozen Q1–Q3 record that rights/construct/parity/gold/prereg were in fact already validated
options.change: new lawful externally attested source-rights and prospectively grounded feasibility evidence, through new owner-approved Q gate
options.tradeoff: No science run or new gold, minimal governance cost, preserves falsifiability, does not imply impossibility

risks.control: Candidate frame, REJECT/abstain reasons and threshold prospective; no outcome-aware filtering
Typed entity/location/time and source completeness; explicit negation/exclusivity; missing record=REJECT, not UNKNOWN_VALID

risks.mode: Hidden gold and loss of effective-view facts after truncation
risks.control: Exact builder/tokenizer/window, all label-changing facts in model and rater views; gate HOLD/item REJECT

risks.mode: Raters agree but share wrong ontology
risks.control: Independent source-grounded blind adjudication, correctness, abstain
AD-01R and owner lawful scope BEFORE access; AD-02/03/05 after lawful limited inspection and BEFORE production authoring
Matched, counterbalanced, group-disjoint fact-only vs cue-only comparisons if causal attribution claimed

risks.mode: Adaptive primary reject and endpoint threshold
risks.control: Freeze sampling, all reasons, deterministic primary precedence, metric, n/uncertainty, STOP and budget pre-outcomes

risks.mode: Unauthorized checkpoint, sealed TEST/FINAL or runner
risks.control: No run before rights+byte custody+owner science permit

reentry: A new lawful evidence package and registered owner-approved question; no automatic re-open or execution
